name: compound-writing
description: A writing system that helps users define a voice, adapt it by destination, and improve guidance with approval.

interface.longDescription: Compound Writing helps users move from ideas to publishable work across longform, X, and LinkedIn. It keeps voice, destination style, and public-positioning strategy in user-owned files, then proposes improvements for approval as patterns emerge.
defaultPrompt: Set up my writing workspace and voice.
Help me develop this idea into the right destination.
Review this draft against my voice.md.
